conditions.input_ramp_definition: Full 0–100% linear voltage ramp; synchronized when multiple inputs change.
conditions.delay_reference: Input edge START; final entry into ideal +/-0.5 V band, staying through observation end.
conditions.output_slew_definition: Last directional 10% to 90% crossings of the ideal output step; null for unchanged output or missing crossings.

scope: Nominal device-only PDK extraction; no cell wire C or poly R in the primary timing model. Add PNR net wire C separately; do not double count cell-pin metal.

input_capacitance.method: Biased unloaded-output AC driving-point C from current SIM public input_capacitance; no added cell wire C.

interpolation: Only within both measured axes and through passing/non-null samples. No implicit extrapolation.

poly_resistance.parameter_origin: PDK RS resistor-poly specification used as a GC sensitivity proxy; GC applicability is uncalibrated.
